answer: Agents store last-step hashes inside a vault that relinks to a rotating wharf schedule. Before moving or wandering, each agent must resubmit and wait N holes on the wharf; the vault punishes missed slots by resetting the hash. Fake identities must reappear every N slots to avoid stale hashes, adding N×256ms per new Sybil. Parallel farms cannot compress time between slots—each extra agent must wait its turn.
